candidates.title: ODSC AI x NEBIUS | Hackathon
candidates.evidence:
ODSC AI x NEBIUS | Hackathon
Hyatt Regency San Francisco Airport
Burlingame, CA
**October 28, 2026 · 9:00 AM–7:30 PM PT · Burlingame, CA**
**Free to apply · Limited spots**
​Bring an idea. Spend the day building it with other AI builders, Nebius tools, and engineers who can help when you get stuck. We’ll start with coffee and team formation, then get everyone set up for a full day of hacking. You’ll finish by showing what you built.
​Come with a team, find one when you arrive, or work solo.

**​What you can build**
​Choose a direction that interests you:

* ​Agents and agentic workflows
* ​Coding and developer tools
* ​Personal AI assistants
* ​Inference and performance
* ​An open track for your own idea

​Final tracks, partner challenges, and prizes will be announced before the event.

### Nebius challenge: Build a research agent that brings its sources

Build an agent that turns a question into a sourced, verifiable answer. Use **Nebius Token Factory** for open-model inference and **Tavily** for real-time web search, so people can check the sources behind your agent’s answer.
**Requirements:**

* Run inference on Nebius Token Factory.
* Use Tavily for web search.
* Share a public repository with a README.
* Prepare a short demo of what you built.

**Get started:** Follow the [deep research agent cookbook](https://dev.nebius.com/cookbook/deep-research-agent-tavily) and claim [free Nebius credits](https://dev.nebius.com/builders).

**​What you’ll have access to**
​Teams can use **Nebius AI Cloud** for GPU compute and **Nebius Token Factory** credits to work with open-source models. Nebius engineers will be on the floor throughout the day to help you get from idea to working demo.
​The day at a glance
​*Tentative schedule, Pacific Time*

* ​**9:00 AM** — Check-in, coffee, and team formation
* ​**10:00 AM** — Kickoff and Nebius workshop
* ​**11:00 AM** — Hacking begins
* ​**1:00 PM** — Break
* ​**5:30 PM** — Submissions close
* ​**6:00 PM** — Demos and judging
* ​**7:30 PM** — Winners announced

​Who should apply?
​AI and ML engineers, data scientists, developers, agent builders, and startup teams, anyone ready to spend the day building. Bring your laptop, charger, and an idea.
​**You don’t need an ODSC AI West pass to apply.** Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Accepted participants will receive venue and setup details by email.
​*Co-hosted by ODSC AI and Nebius at ODSC AI West 2026.*

candidates.title: Robot Hackathon: Harnessing Physical AI & Data
candidates.evidence:
Robot Hackathon: Harnessing Physical AI & Data 
Robotics Center of Silicon Valley
San Francisco, CA
Join **[Viam](https://www.linkedin.com/company/viaminc/)** and **[MongoDB](https://www.linkedin.com/company/mongodbinc/)** for a hands-on Robot Hackathon in San Francisco, October 29–30, 2026! Build with real robot arms, explore Physical AI, and compete to win a robot arm kit plus up to $10,000 in credits per winning team.

No robotics experience required—just bring your ideas and a laptop! 🚀

📍 Robotics Center of Silicon Valley, San Francisco
🔗 Register now: [https://luma.com/ta40197s](https://luma.com/ta40197s)

Space is limited, and approval is required. Sign up today!
